instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: The instruction wants Glitch to use the stimpak on himself, but the page offers no verb for using an item — only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse. Offer requires a target and moves the item to another person's hands, so no sequence of the available verbs ends with Glitch jabbing the stimpak into his own arm.
